anatomy.flutter: Three separate StatefulWidgets -- PieChart (wedges via _buildPie + sectorPath), RadarChart (polygon via polarPolygonPath + PolarGrid rings/spokes), RadialBarChart (concentric arcs via sectorPath/sectorWithCornerPath) -- each with its own painter (_PiePainter/_RadarPainter/_RadialPainter) and shared helpers _ArcChip/_PolarText/_PolarLabel/_PolarTooltipLayout, matching the doc page's own framing: 'the real PieChart / RadarChart / RadialBarChart from components/ds/charts/{pie,radar,radial}.tsx'.
anatomy.web: Three Recharts component families composed per demo in components/ds/charts/{pie,radar,radial}.tsx: PieChart+Pie+Sector+Label+LabelList, RadarChart+Radar+PolarGrid+PolarAngleAxis+PolarRadiusAxis, RadialBarChart+RadialBar+PolarGrid, all wrapped in the shared ChartContainer/ChartTooltipContent/ChartLegendContent.

api.flutter: PieSpec({data, dataKey, nameKey, innerRadius, outerRadius, startAngle, endAngle, paddingAngle, strokeWidth, activeIndex, activeGrow, activeRing, outsideLabel, labelLine, labelBuilder, chipLabelKey}); RadarSpec({dataKey, fill, fillOpacity, stroke, strokeWidth, dot}); RadialBarSpec({dataKey, fill, background, cornerRadius, stackId, chipLabelKey}); PolarGrid/PolarAngleAxis/PolarRadiusAxis mirror the Recharts components of the same name.
api.web: Recharts' Pie(data, dataKey, nameKey, innerRadius, outerRadius, startAngle, endAngle, paddingAngle, stroke, activeIndex, activeShape), Radar(dataKey, fill, fillOpacity, stroke, strokeWidth, dot), RadialBar(dataKey, fill, background, cornerRadius, stackId), PolarGrid(gridType, radialLines, polarRadius), PolarAngleAxis(dataKey, tick, axisLine, tickLine), PolarRadiusAxis(angle, tick, axisLine).

states.flutter: _hover/_hoverLocal tracked in _PieChartState/_RadialBarChartState via MouseRegion + _pieIndexAt/_radialIndexAt (angle/radius hit-testing against the pointer, documented as the polar analogue of _CartesianLayout.indexAt); PieSpec.activeIndex/activeGrow/activeRing model the grown/detached-ring active-slice look; each chart has its own AnimationController seeded and reset the same way as CartesianChart's entrance.
states.web: Recharts' own hover/active-index tracking for Pie/RadialBar plus activeIndex/activeShape props for the grown-slice look; entrance driven by useChartMotion()'s animationDuration/animationEasing passthrough.

disabled.flutter: No disabled concept on any of the three polar charts -- they are read-only visualisations.
disabled.note: A chart is not a control; this dimension does not apply.

interaction.flutter: MouseRegion.onHover installed only when widget.tooltip != null (documented cost-avoidance: 'a chart with no widget.tooltip pays nothing for hover it can never render'), driving _pieIndexAt/_radialIndexAt angle-and-radius hit tests; no keyboard-driven slice selection on either side.
interaction.web: Recharts activates a slice/arc's tooltip on pointer hover via its own internal hit-testing against the SVG geometry; no keyboard interaction for selecting a specific wedge/arc is documented on the chart-polar page either.

semantics.flutter: _ArcChip explicitly paints on theme.card/theme.cardForeground rather than on the wedge's own fill, with the widget's own doc comment citing the measured luminance problem ('--chart-1 ... measured relative luminance is 0.179... 4.58 is the ceiling for any ink whatsoever') that a literal port of Pie's label-on-fill approach would have reproduced; _PolarText likewise paints outside labels on theme.foreground, never on the slice's own colour.
semantics.web: ui/chart.tsx's ChartContainer className sweep [&_.recharts-pie-label-text]:fill-foreground documented in pie.tsx's own header takes outside pie labels off their slice's colour and onto --foreground for the same measured-contrast reason.
